title: 15.5. Hetuduka, Saṅkiliṭṭhattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Hetuṁ saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nahetuṁ asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nanahetu naasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Hetuṁ asaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesikaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu naasaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
